name: Tachibana Tsubame
source:
Tsubame is the starting point of the story and also Sayuki's older twin sister. She is a model student who puts on a facade and looks down on most people. She is also hardworking and doesn't show her struggles to others, but this is all because she feels that her younger sister is the only one who is loved by those around her.

Having never received genuine affection from others, her personality has become warped.

[Edited from the official site]
